newsitem.title: USA: OPTi sees weak Q2, FY97 results.
newsitem.headline: OPTi sees weak Q2, FY97 results.

text.p: OPTi Inc said Friday it expects to report a loss for its second quarter and for fiscal 1997.

OPTi said it expects to report sales of about $15 million to $17 million for its second quarter, ended June 30. OPTi said it expects a loss of between $0.30 and $0.45 for the quarter, including a restructuring charge, and a net operating loss for the fiscal year.
Analysts had expected the company to post a second quarter loss of $0.03 a share compared with a loss of $0.66 in the year-ago quarter, according to First Call.
The weaker results were attributed to softening in demand and price declines for audio controllers.

The company hopes to partially offset the revenue decline by reducing its operating expenses in the near term to be more in line with expected revenues. The reduction in operating expenses and the associated charges will be part of an unspecified restructuring charge taken in the second quarter.
The company said that demand for its notebook products met expectations but that demand for audio controllers in the Far Eastern and European markets has fallen off significantly.
